FN-NFYQ8J-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 356
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Leigh Hulsey
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/25/2023
House Bill 356 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama
Peace Officers' Standards and Training Commission (APOSTC) to require the implementation
of annual training on interacting with individuals with sensory needs or invisible disabilities, as
part of continuing education requirements for law enforcement. This bill would require
APOSTC to collaborate with a non-profit company to administer this training and provide it at
no-cost to individuals.
